RADICO.d: Radico Khaitan Limited manufactures and sells Indian Made Foreign Liquor, country liquor, and industrial alcohol. It is one of the oldest and largest liquor manufacturers in India.

RAILTEL.d: Railtel Corporation of India provides telecom and broadband services, alongside modernization of railway signaling infrastructure. It is a state-owned enterprise under the Ministry of Railways.

RAIN.d: Rain Industries Limited produces calcined petroleum coke, coal tar pitch, and advanced materials. It serves the aluminum, carbon, and construction industries globally.

RAINBOW.d: Rainbow Childrens Medicare Limited operates a chain of multi-specialty pediatric, obstetrics, and gynecology hospitals in India. It provides comprehensive healthcare services focused on maternal and child care.

RAMCOCEM.d: The Ramco Cements Limited manufactures and sells portland cement, ready-mix concrete, and dry mortar products. Its primary customers are the construction and infrastructure sectors across southern and eastern India.

RAMRAT.d: Ram Ratna Wires Limited manufactures winding wires, enamelled copper wires, and power cables used in electrical and industrial applications. It supplies electrical products to transformer and motor manufacturers.

RATEGAIN.d: Rategain Travel Technologies Limited provides software-as-a-service solutions for travel and hospitality pricing, distribution, and intelligence. Its customers include hotels, airlines, online travel agencies, and car rental companies.

RATNAMANI.d: Ratnamani Metals & Tubes Limited manufactures stainless steel and carbon steel pipes and tubes. It serves industrial sectors such as oil and gas, petrochemicals, and power across domestic and international markets.

RAYMOND.d: Raymond Limited manufactures textiles, apparel, and engineering components. Its customers include retail consumers, global apparel brands, and industrial clients.

RBA.d: Restaurant Brands Asia operates quick-service restaurants, holding the master franchise for Burger King in India and Indonesia. It serves retail consumers through dine-in, take-away, and delivery channels.

RBLBANK.d: RBL Bank Limited provides commercial and retail banking services, including corporate banking and financial advisory. It operates an extensive network of branches and automated teller machines across India.

RCF.d: Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers Limited manufactures fertilizers and industrial chemicals, including urea and complex fertilizers. It is a state-owned enterprise primarily serving the Indian agricultural sector.

RECLTD.d: The financial institution provides long-term loans and other financial products for power sector infrastructure projects across India. It is a state-owned enterprise under the Ministry of Power.

REDINGTON.d: Redington Limited distributes IT and mobility products, serving as a supply-chain partner for global technology brands. It supplies products to enterprise customers, retail vendors, and e-commerce platforms across multiple geographies.

REDTAPE.d: Redtape Limited designs, manufactures, and markets footwear, apparel, and accessories under its flagship brand. It serves retail consumers in India through exclusive brand outlets, multi-brand stores, and e-commerce platforms.

RELAXO.d: Relaxo Footwears Limited manufactures rubber, plastic, and synthetic footwear. It sells its products directly to retail consumers across India through distributors and retail outlets.

RELIANCE.d: Reliance Industries operates in hydrocarbons refining, petrochemicals, retail, and digital services across India. It is the country's largest company by revenue and holds a dominant market position.

RELIGARE.d: Religare Enterprises Limited operates as a core investment company offering financial services through its subsidiaries. These services include SME finance, health insurance, and retail broking for individual and institutional clients.

RHIM.d: RHI Magnesita India Limited manufactures refractory products used in high-temperature industrial processes. Its main customers are steel, cement, non-ferrous metals, and glass manufacturers.

RITES.d: RITES provides transport consultancy and engineering services in railways, highways, ports, and urban transport. It is a public sector enterprise under the Ministry of Railways, Government of India.

RKFORGE.d: Ramkrishna Forgings manufactures metal forgings and machined components for automotive, railway, and engineering sectors. Its customers include global commercial vehicle manufacturers and industrial equipment producers.

ROLEXRINGS.d: Rolex Rings Limited manufactures forged and machined automotive components, bearing rings, and related parts. Its main customers are global automotive and bearing manufacturers.

ROSSTECH.d: Rossell Techsys Limited manufactures aerospace and defense components, wiring harnesses, and electronic systems. Its main customers are global aerospace and defense original equipment manufacturers.

RPEL.d: Raghav Productivity Enhancers manufactures quartz-based ramming mass and tundish board products used in induction furnaces. It is a significant global producer of silica ramming mass for the steel industry.

RPOWER.d: Reliance Power Limited develops, constructs, and operates power projects in India. It generates and supplies electricity to state utilities, industrial consumers, and distribution companies.

RPSGVENT.ind: Business Process Outsourcing (BPO)/ Knowledge Process Outsourcing (KPO)

RRKABEL.d: R R Kabel Limited manufactures and sells a wide range of electrical wires, cables, and consumer electrical products including fans and switches. It caters to residential, commercial, and industrial markets.

RVNL.d: Rail Vikas Nigam Limited executes rail infrastructure projects for the Indian Railways on a turnkey basis. It is a state-owned enterprise responsible for project development, design, and construction.
